scope: Editable sheet-layout conventions only; no physical or code clearance values
placement_rules: Check actual text bounds and final print scale; nominal gap does not prove legibility.
Reserve clear zones around terminals, switch contacts, junctions, conductor elbows and revision marks.
Anchor related labels to the same subject/occurrence; preserve space for longer real identifiers.
Use native annotations for resolved text and actual conductors/report topology for electrical continuity.
Do not stretch physical icons or use annotation offsets as electrical/fire/service clearance.
Keep work scope, revision, operating mode, component condition and review status independent.
